items.title: iFAST Global Bank Expands Multi-Currency Visa Debit Card Access to Overseas Customers
items.summary: The expansion brings multi-currency spending and virtual debit card access to iFAST Global Bank customers across seven overseas markets.Key facts: Launch: iFAST Global Bank is expanding virtual access to its Multi-Currency Visa Debit Card to customers across seven overseas markets: Thailand, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, Pakistan, and Germany.Purpose: Complementing iFAST Global Bank’s Multi-Currency Current Account, the expansion broadens access of the Bank’s digital banking services b
